Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I purchased two rugs in the past that…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a45899f724a2d55ed74b7d2)
I purchased two rugs in the past that were delivered by Metropolitan Warehouse, which justified the expensive shipping costs. I purchased my third rug from Lulu and Georgia in this order while it was back ordered, assuming I would be contacted to schedule delivery like in the past. This rug shipped out through FedEx, despite having the same incredibly shipping cost as previous orders. I had a vacation hold in place on my FedEx account, but the rug was delivered regardless and I had to have a neighbor use a spare key to drag it inside. Incredibly upset that I spent almost $300 on shipping for such a terrible experience.

June 26, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 6, 2026

Hi Megan,

Thank you for your feedback. I understand your frustration regarding the shipping process. Our items ship directly from suppliers, and unfortunately, orders cannot be delayed or held due to space limitations at our warehouses. We recommend having your items delivered to a location where someone can receive them. The shipping fee varies depending on the shipping method and merchandise total. Please let us know if you have any specific items you would like to discuss further, and I’ll be happy to help.

Lulu and Georgia
